description: This file defines a reusable UI component named VoiceSearchBar for Android applications. The component provides a search input field with an integrated microphone button that triggers speech-to-text functionality via RecognizerIntent. It manages permissions, handles speech recognition results, and allows configuration via public methods. The class is designed to simplify adding voice search capabilities to an Android app's UI.

classes.name: VoiceSearchBar
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout that encapsulates an EditText and microphone button to facilitate voice-based search input in Android applications.

methods.name: setHostActivity
methods.description: Associates an Activity that facilitates permission requests and activity results for speech recognition.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the current text from the search input field.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the specified text into the search input field and positions the cursor at the end.

methods.name: addQueryTextChangedListener
methods.description: Allows external code to listen for changes in the search input text.

methods.name: handleSpeechResult
methods.description: Processes activity result data to extract speech recognition results and populates the search field accordingly.

methods.name: handlePermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the outcome of permission requests, especially for microphone access, and resumes speech input if permitted.
